name: Physics
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator who established the physical universe, laying the foundations of the earth and heavens by His hand. From the creation of light and the separation of darkness in Genesis to the earth hanging upon nothing in Job, the Bible affirms God's power over the unseen forces and structures that govern the cosmos. This understanding affirms that all physical laws and phenomena, including those explored in subtopics like quantum physics, ultimately reflect the order and design of the Creator.
